pack.title: Water Basics (Example)
pack.description: Illustrative example pack: basic water collection and treatment steps. Educational sample content for the ODY format.

sources.title: General public water safety guidance (illustrative example)

entries.title: Collecting water
entries.summary: Prefer the clearest available water source and collect water rather than drinking it directly from the wild.
entries.detail: Standing water and fast-moving water both need treatment before drinking. Collect water in a clean container and keep it covered.
decision_rules: If water is cloudy, let it settle or filter it before treating
When in doubt, treat the water
prohibitions: Do not drink untreated water from wild sources
Do not mix untreated and treated water

entries.title: Treating water by boiling
entries.summary: Boiling is a common method to make water safer to drink when fuel is available.
entries.detail: Bring the water to a rolling boil and let it boil before removing it from the heat. Let it cool in a clean, covered container.
actions: Bring water to a rolling boil
Let it boil before removing from heat
Cool it in a clean covered container
checklist: A reliable heat source is available
A clean container is ready for cooling
decision_rules: If fuel is limited, prioritize treating water for drinking over other uses
If no heat source is available, use an alternative treatment method
prohibitions: Do not treat water with unknown chemicals
Do not store treated water in an unclean container

entries.title: Storing treated water
entries.summary: Store treated water in clean, sealed containers and keep track of when it was treated.
entries.detail: Label containers with the treatment date and use the oldest treated water first. Keep containers out of direct sunlight where possible.
actions: Label containers with the treatment date
Use the oldest treated water first
Keep containers sealed and out of direct sunlight
decision_rules: If the water smells or looks wrong, do not drink it and treat a fresh batch
prohibitions: Do not reuse a container that held unknown substances
Do not drink water of uncertain origin
